displacement_band_weights — 3D terrain op

• 数据种类:mesh → matrix

• 调用:import render3d; render3d.displacement_band_weights(V, F, wavelengths=(0.06, 0.03, 0.015, 0.0075, 0.00375), *, nyquist: 'float' = 2.0, fade: 'float' = 1.0, local_edge=None) -> 'np.ndarray'(或 ops3d.get("displacement_band_weights"))

用法

逐倍频、逐顶点的频带门 `(K, N)`,取值 [0,1]:网格能承载该频带处为 1。
